summary.text: Amy Lunde is the Libertarian candidate for the Colorado House of Representatives, District 56, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces incumbent Republican Chris Richardson.

paragraphs.text: Lunde was a Libertarian candidate for Colorado House District 19 at the party's April 13, 2020 convention and appeared on the November 2022 general election ballot for District 56, which incumbent Rod Bockenfeld won.
